method: Operational reconstruction from trusted NWS observed statements and fire-weather products. Missing upstream or upper-air station values remain null; no values are inferred solely to complete the schema. Fire association is an outcome field only.

pressure.trend: strengthening offshore/northerly support into the evening; exact multi-hour numerical series unavailable

upstream.data_quality_note: Trusted archived values were not recovered for this run and are intentionally not estimated.

model_upper_air_context.synoptic_pattern: 597-dam upper high centered over the Texas/Oklahoma Panhandles with a weak trough over California
model_upper_air_context.surface_pattern: moderate to strong east-west onshore gradient with a diurnally offshore north-south gradient supporting western Santa Ynez Range downslope flow

Gaviota.notes: Named by NWS as one of the strongest observed locations.

Refugio.notes: Named by NWS as one of the strongest observed locations.

Goleta.notes: No trusted source in this run documented advisory-level impacts in this zone.

San Marcos Pass.notes: Included in the adjacent western Santa Ynez Range advisory/forecast impact area; exact observed peak not recovered.

regional_thermodynamics.scope_note: These RH and temperature descriptors are from the NWS fire-weather discussion for the broader affected region, not a substitute for missing zone-specific station observations.

source_evidence: NWS LOX AFD issued 11:20 PM PDT July 27, 2026: observed southwest Santa Barbara County gusts 35-45 mph, strongest near Refugio and Gaviota; north-south gradient near -3.7 mb at 8 PM; Wind Advisory through 3 AM.
NWS LOX Fire Weather Planning Forecast issued 9:32 AM PDT July 27, 2026: gusty Sundowner winds, RH 8-20 percent, poor overnight recovery, elevated fire weather through the night.
